propositions: Container recreation during landing bursts kills in-flight reviews before they complete voting, leaving the LLM-Review gate unable to converge.

The reconciler's retry path is unprotected by the existing shutdown drain because it awaits review_and_vote inline outside the queue, causing killed reviews to be the mechanism that live-locks the gate.
Health signals (restarts, VOTER_ERROR, CloudWatch alarms) remain green during a live-locked gate because no process failure is emitted when reviews are terminated by design.
Autodeploy now defers container recreation while reviews are in-flight by polling an in_flight counter on the /health endpoint, bounded at 1800s to prevent indefinite blocking.
Deferred deploys are logged as AUTODEPLOY_DEFERRED and review interrupts are counted as AUTODEPLOY_REVIEW_INTERRUPT with a new paging alarm to make the failure mode observable.
